entries.cause: Fleet management goes live under ADR-0283: the production pack authors the fleetManagement section, so the replay executor now runs monthly division cohesion growth of 2 points toward 90 for settled and fully active divisions; checkpoints from the second month onward move. The new fourteen month scenario also exercises special training, a doctrine change and the annual exercise.
entries.migrationAssessment: None needed. No state shape or wire format changes and the compatibility version stays; the new state fields are optional and absent from existing saves, and an old save loads with the section live so cohesion simply starts to grow. Replay files carry the new content hash.
